linhas.txt: Hello, exploradora! Olha essa pedra preta... it's COAL! É uma FLORESTA ESMAGADA de milhões de anos atrás! Yay, que história! Coal, oil and gas são FOSSIL FUELS — a gente queima pra ter energia. MAS... quando acabam, they're gone forever! Let's go!

FOSSIL FUELS = coal, petroleum (oil) and natural gas. They are the remains of organisms that lived long ago (coal from plants; oil and gas from tiny algae). About 90% of our energy comes from burning them.
NONRENEWABLE = once they are used up, they are gone forever (they take millions of years to form).
Burning them releases HARMFUL GASES ACID RAIN and the GREENHOUSE EFFECT (the warming of Earth's atmosphere).
Cleaner alternatives: SOLAR (sun), WIND, WATER and NUCLEAR power.
(This connects to Geografia: renewable × non-renewable energy!)
